entries.3d0cec95414c2b4d: These are machines that process iron, non-ferrous metals and other new materials. Grinding machines include products based on a technical assistance agreement with Timesavers, Inc. of the United States. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,719 million, accounting for 44.6% of total revenue.
entries.5f3ad31f82838258: Companies engaged in sawmilling and wood processing
entries.615f17036a687600: This single-segment business manufactures and sells sawmill and woodworking machinery and machine tools. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,859 million, down 30.3% from the prior year. Products are manufactured at the head office plant in Ise City, Mie Prefecture, and sold through sales offices in Tokyo, Osaka, Nagoya and Kyushu.
entries.7abc0c61f24f83d1: A machinery manufacturer founded in 1897 that manufactures and sells sawmill and woodworking machinery and machine tools.
entries.b2a859ae28612907: These are sawmill machines that process logs into square timber, boards and small-section lumber for construction and woodworking uses, and woodworking machines that further process square timber, boards, small-section lumber, plywood, fiberboard, synthetic resins and similar materials into products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,139 million, accounting for 55.4% of total revenue; this is the core field.
